public with sharing class ContactEmailMatcher {

    public class Request {
        @InvocableVariable(required=true)
        public String email;
    }

    public class Result {
        @InvocableVariable
        public Id contactId;
    }

    @InvocableMethod(label='Match Contact by Email')
    public static List<Result> match(List<Request> requests) {
        List<Result> results = new List<Result>();

        Set<String> queryEmails = new Set<String>();
        Map<Integer, String> requestNormalizedEmail = new Map<Integer, String>();

        for (Integer i = 0; i < requests.size(); i++) {
            String email = requests[i].email;
            String normalized = (email != null) ? email.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
            requestNormalizedEmail.put(i, normalized);

            if (normalized != '') {
                queryEmails.add(normalized);
            }
        }

        Map<String, Contact> normalizedToContact = new Map<String, Contact>();

        if (!queryEmails.isEmpty()) {
            for (Contact c : [
                SELECT Id, Email, CreatedDate
                FROM Contact
                WHERE Email IN :queryEmails
                ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC, Id ASC
            ]) {
                String normalizedContactEmail = (c.Email != null) ? c.Email.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
                if (normalizedContactEmail != '' && !normalizedToContact.containsKey(normalizedContactEmail)) {
                    normalizedToContact.put(normalizedContactEmail, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (Integer i = 0; i < requests.size(); i++) {
            Result r = new Result();
            String normalized = requestNormalizedEmail.get(i);
            if (normalized != '' && normalizedToContact.containsKey(normalized)) {
                r.contactId = normalizedToContact.get(normalized).Id;
            }
            results.add(r);
        }

        return results;
    }
}

public inherited sharing class TA_Case_RollupOpenCount
        implements TriggerAction.AfterInsert,
                   TriggerAction.AfterUpdate,
                   TriggerAction.AfterDelete,
                   TriggerAction.AfterUndelete {

    /**
     * Keeps Account.FB_Open_Case_Count__c equal to the number of the account's
     * Cases where IsClosed = false.
     *
     * For every account touched by the trigger, the open case count is
     * recomputed from the database (ground truth). This makes the logic
     * identical for inserts, updates (close / reopen / move), deletes and
     * undeletes. Cases without an Account are ignored. An account whose last
     * open case disappears is written as 0 so the field is never left blank.
     *
     * Bulk-safe: one read SOQL query and a single upsert DML per trigger
     * execution. Only accounts whose stored value would change are written.
     */

    public void afterInsert(List<SObject> triggerNew) {
        apply(triggerNew);
    }

    public void afterUpdate(List<SObject> triggerNew, List<SObject> triggerOld) {
        // Both sides are needed so a status change and an account move are
        // both reflected for the affected accounts.
        List<SObject> cases = new List<SObject>();
        if (triggerNew != null) {
            cases.addAll(triggerNew);
        }
        if (triggerOld != null) {
            cases.addAll(triggerOld);
        }
        apply(cases);
    }

    public void afterDelete(List<SObject> triggerOld) {
        apply(triggerOld);
    }

    public void afterUndelete(List<SObject> triggerNew) {
        apply(triggerNew);
    }

    private void apply(List<SObject> cases) {
        if (cases == null || cases.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        // Accounts touched by these cases. Cases without an Account are ignored.
        Set<Id> accountIds = new Set<Id>();
        for (SObject c : cases) {
            Id acctId = (Id) c.get('AccountId');
            if (acctId != null) {
                accountIds.add(acctId);
            }
        }
        if (accountIds.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        // Single SOQL query: accounts with their open case counts via subquery.
        // After delete/undelete this reflects the new ground truth.
        List<Account> accounts = [
            SELECT Id,
                   FB_Open_Case_Count__c,
                   (SELECT Id FROM Cases WHERE IsClosed = false) OpenCases
            FROM Account
            WHERE Id IN :accountIds
        ];

        List<Account> accountsToUpdate = new List<Account>();
        for (Account a : accounts) {
            Integer openCount = a.OpenCases.size();
            if (openCount != a.FB_Open_Case_Count__c) {
                a.FB_Open_Case_Count__c = openCount;
                accountsToUpdate.add(a);
            }
        }

        if (!accountsToUpdate.isEmpty()) {
            upsert accountsToUpdate;
        }
    }
}
